content: Phase 3a: Get auth playbook + refreshed design guidelines
Phase 3b: Backend auth (signup/login/me, JWT, bcrypt, seed user, test bypass) + user scoping
Phase 3c: Frontend auth (login/signup, AuthContext, interceptor, protected routes)
Phase 3d: Apply modern design refresh (tokens, color-coded nav/badges, contrast)
Phase 3e: End-to-end testing (98.5% pass, no real bugs)
